qualification_gaps: The ten archives contain different task subsets; noncompilable and compilable-only samples are not runtime-performance cases.
Per-record execution, defined-behavior checks, finite IO coverage and source provenance need admission.
Upstream public splits do not establish absence of agent pretraining contamination or project-family leakage.
Logical expanded bytes, extraction peak and admitted-data derivative sizes need local measurement.
catalog.redistribution_status: Authors license their contributions under MIT; extracted functions retain original repository licenses and require per-record review.
catalog.size_basis: Exact sum of ten archive sizes declared by the author-hosted immutable Hugging Face Git-LFS tree; SHA256 is provided separately for every archive. Payloads were not downloaded in this audit. Nested zstd logical size remains unmeasured.
